messages:
alex: Quick sync — Console observability retention milestone: who owns the final dashboard rollout, current blockers, and tracing hook merge status? Need clear owners + dependencies for the product milestone on Mon. TL;DR please. @maya @jordan

maya: Owning dashboards. Most widgets are done; two missing pieces: error-rate heatmap and per-route cost breakdown. ETA for heatmap = Fri EOD. Cost breakdown blocked on billing API bug (see billing-issue-284).

jordan: I own the tracing hooks PR. Link: https://github.com/redwood/trace-hooks/pull/412. Left a perf test comment — once resolved CI should be green. CI is flaky on model-kv test but unrelated. @simon can you nudge runtime for a quick review? :eyes:

simon: On it. Runtime team will prioritize the review tomorrow AM. Heads-up: to show span-level metadata in the console we need a small KV cache schema change which may add ~2 days (migrate + deploy). We can ship a reduced span payload as fallback to avoid the schema bump.

maya: Retention proposal: 90d default, 365d for enterprise. Planning to add a sample config to docs: 
```
observability:
  retention_days: 90
  enterprise_retention_days: 365
  trace_index_shards: 12
```
Need infra to confirm storage/cost estimate before we lock this.

ops-bot: deploy/observability-console v1.8.3 failed at step 'es-migrate' — index mapping conflict. CI log: https://ci.redwood/example/987. Tagging infra-team.

alex: Two asks: 1) @jordan — can you get the PR to reviewable state by EOD tomorrow so we can canary? 2) @maya — please create an issue tying the cost breakdown widget to billing-issue-284 and assign owners. I'll coordinate with PM. If runtime KV change is required, mark it as a hard dependency in the milestone. :thumbsup:

jordan: Will rebase, run perf, and ping reviewers tomorrow. If runtime change needed I'll include an alternate payload (omits dense span fields) to avoid schema migration.

simon: Runtime ETA if schema change required: ~48 hours for change + next deploy window. If we do canary we should add a feature flag in the console to toggle the richer spans. I'll open a small PR for the flag.

maya: Creating tickets now and adding owners + acceptance criteria. Also FYI: dashboard UX review scheduled Thu 10:00am — invite sent to eng-platform and product.

alex: Awesome — I'll update the milestone doc with owners/deps and link the tracing PR + billing issue. If anyone hits a blocker before the doc update, ping here and I'll triage. :shipit:
